verdict.rationale: Luma documents a Dream Machine API for video generation (text-to-video, image-to-video, video-to-video). It offers a dedicated generation endpoint, Python/JS/TS SDKs, API key management and per-video credit pricing, and the docs site is live with llms.txt. Retrieving the finished asset is only implied: no cited item describes job status, polling or download, and no OpenAPI spec was found at standard paths. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of job status/polling and asset retrieval, a machine-readable API spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of the API workflow.
